integrity: The proof independently normalizes every published facet inside the affine hyperplane, derives a uniform lower bound for all sufficiently large facet supports, isolates the only five small support/ambient pairs not covered by the coarse inequality, verifies those pairs by exact rational certificates, and obtains global optimality plus uniqueness from the complete family of singleton facets. Finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the Baralic--Ivanovic--Petric standard halfspace realization for n>=2. It does not transfer to arbitrary normally equivalent or combinatorially equivalent realizations and does not determine the circumradius, John ellipsoid, or full metric geometry. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent unpublished observation about the same explicit realization.
title: The standard simple permutoassociahedron has a unique singleton-facet inball
